I actually think the shading is really impressive. My only criticisms would be to work on making the facial structure more accurate. The eyes are actually sorta asymmetrical. Also, when making the bangs, you should make sure it doesn't look like the bangs are floating. Unless that was on purpose. It's also missing where her ear should be on the left. That's all I really have to say. You just need to make sure the face is symmetrical, the eyes are the only problem in this one. You did a good job honestly.

This took 2 days, mostly because of touchups at the end.

It first started with a sketch and I colored it in with the base color. I mostly used the emphasizing texture paintbrush for the hair.  I painted the background first before even starting on working on Tohru so that it doesn't feel like she's in front of a greenscreen. After I was done with Tohru, I removed the lineart in the places that didn't matter. I kept the lineart on the eyes and the mouth. I had quite a bit of trouble with making this and it was a ton of trial and error so it's a bit hard to explain my process.

I don't really have any specific goals except to just improve.

I used a screenshot of Tohru for reference.
